assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. assets.name: packing
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Wide 3:2 photorealistic B2B packaging editorial image. Three-quarter overhead view of an open plain kraft corrugated carton with a single-layer two-by-three divider grid, six individual cells. Each cell contains exactly one small empty clear short tapered shot glass upright, heavy transparent base, intact rim, no handles. Divider walls surround and separate every glass, no glass-to-glass contact, no cardboard crossing through glass, sufficient clearance and credible near-rim-height dividers. Include a visible flat bottom pad inside and a separate matching flat top pad lying beside the carton. Plain kraft surfaces, light warm stone table, soft natural studio daylight, whole carton in frame, realistic paper fibers and glass reflections. No branding, writing, labels, numbers, arrows, hands, stamps, test badges, liquids, stacks, gift ribbon or watermarks. Generic packaging concept only, not a six-piece carton specification or a tested pack.
